subject: Getting REPORTed variables from a tmbstan fit

messages.author: 111f458109435bea
messages.subject: Getting REPORTed variables from a tmbstan fit
parts:
What is the best way to get REPORTed variables from a `tmbstan` fit? Do you need to call `obj$fn(parval)` then `obj$report()` for each vector of `parval` in the MCMC chains?

Thanks,
John

messages.author: 395bdca538bcae5d
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Getting REPORTed variables from a tmbstan fit
parts: John: Yes I think you just need to loop through the returned MCMC draws and pass them to obj$report(parval)) and that will give a posterior distribution for any reported quantities. I haven't tried it but should work. -Cole

messages.author: 111f458109435bea
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Getting REPORTed variables from a tmbstan fit
parts:
Thanks Cole!

For future reference, something like this worked for me, where I have an `obj` from `MakeADFun` and a `stanfit` object called `fit`. Note that you have to specify parameter names so that you don't get the posterior `lp__` samples out.

post <- as.matrix(fit, pars = c(...))
postrep <- apply(X = post, MARGIN = 1, FUN = obj$report)

This returns a list of `report()`s, which will take some list-fu to unnest to be usable, but the samples are there.

--John
